subsystems.name: Superconducting compound
subsystems.role: carries electric current with zero resistance when Cooper pairs form.

subsystems.name: Pairing mechanism
subsystems.role: binds electrons into Cooper pairs so they move without scattering.

subsystems.name: Stabilization matrix
subsystems.role: keeps the metastable superconducting phase intact at ambient pressure and temperature.

subsystems.name: Current leads and joints
subsystems.role: connect the superconductor to normal metal without resistive heating.

subsystems.name: Wire or tape architecture
subsystems.role: turns a brittle material into a flexible conductor for cables and magnets.

buildSteps.title: Choose a candidate composition
buildSteps.detail: Select a hydrogen-rich hydride with a metal or metalloid, guided by theory that predicts strong electron-phonon coupling.

buildSteps.title: Synthesize under high pressure
buildSteps.detail: Compress the elements in a diamond anvil cell or multi-anvil press and heat them to form the desired crystal phase.

buildSteps.title: Confirm superconductivity
buildSteps.detail: Measure the drop to zero resistance and the Meissner effect to prove the material is superconducting.

buildSteps.title: Reduce the required pressure
buildSteps.detail: Attempt chemical doping, strain, or nanostructuring to stabilize the phase at lower pressure, aiming for ambient conditions.

buildSteps.title: Grow bulk or thin-film samples
buildSteps.detail: Once stable at ambient pressure, deposit the material as thin films or synthesize bulk pellets for testing.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate a wire or tape
buildSteps.detail: Deposit the superconductor onto a flexible substrate with buffer layers to create a usable conductor.

buildSteps.title: Test current capacity
buildSteps.detail: Measure how much current the conductor can carry and how it withstands bending, heat cycling and magnetic fields.

buildSteps.title: Integrate into a device
buildSteps.detail: Build a prototype cable or magnet and demonstrate lossless operation under real-world conditions.

pathway.unlocks: proof that superconductivity near room temperature is physically possible.

pathway.unlocks: experiments that can be carried out outside diamond anvil cells.

pathway.unlocks: prototype lossless cables and compact magnets.

pathway.unlocks: lossless power grids, maglev transport and compact fusion magnets.
